name: BGF retail Co. Ltd.
summary: BGF retail Co., Ltd. is a South Korean corporation primarily involved in operating convenience stores and managing a franchising enterprise. The company also produces and distributes a variety of fresh food products, including prepared meals like lunchboxes, rice balls, and sushi, as well as sandwiches, hamburgers, and a broad range of other goods. Founded in 1994, its main office is situated in Seoul, South Korea.
